Position information occurs as relative-position bias inside attention, NOT absolute position embedding added at input. Show source missing span location and matching sentinel markers (blank symbols later fonts), decoder causal small3x3grid, cross allsourcegrid, FFN and normalization, output3probability slots. Source and target tokenrowaligned, new balanced composition. Preserve sentinel nextboundary objective, not BERTperpositionMLM.
